claims.statement: Article 7 of Regulation (EU) 2024/573 requires specified equipment records and generally requires operators and service undertakings to retain them for at least five years.
UDT states that Polish businesses installing or servicing stationary refrigeration, air-conditioning, or heat-pump equipment containing F-gases require relevant certification.

contrary_evidence: Existing contractor software and authority databases may already satisfy basic record-keeping without a paid intermediary.

economics.acquisition_route: One-to-many distribution through refrigerant wholesalers, training centers, and the founder's family installation network as pilot.
economics.founder_net_worth_path: Hypothesis: 600 contractors producing 350 PLN monthly equivalent revenue by year four yields about 2.5 million PLN ARR, supporting founder equity above 5 million PLN at a modest software multiple without counting retained earnings twice.
economics.founder_time: Hypothesis: 3 founder hours daily after launch because wholesalers handle onboarding and support can be delegated.
economics.gross_margin_basis: Hypothesis: 70-80% gross margin after digital signatures, support, storage, and wholesaler revenue share.
economics.payback: Hypothesis: a 12000 PLN wholesaler integration pays back in nine months at 80 active contractor accounts.
economics.pricing: Hypothesis, including the capital figure: 39 PLN per completed service event plus 149 PLN monthly per contractor account.
economics.retention_or_repeat: Leak checks, additions, recovery, repairs, and decommissioning each create a new paid ledger event.

fingerprint.compounding_advantage: Permissioned serial-level service and failure histories improve reminders, anomaly detection, and warranty evidence
fingerprint.customer: Polish heat-pump and refrigeration service contractors
fingerprint.distribution_mechanism: Wholesaler checkout and certified-technician training portals
fingerprint.offer_and_business_model: Co-branded asset ledger sold per service event and contractor subscription
fingerprint.payer_and_paid_event: The contractor or equipment operator pays when a compliant service record is signed
fingerprint.problem_trigger: A regulated asset is installed, leak-checked, charged, repaired, or retired

founder_fit: The family renewable-energy channel enables a low-cost pilot while the workflow rewards automation rather than constant selling.
risks: The ledger must not imply certification and must preserve regulator access, confidentiality, and accurate technician identity.

structure.control_point: The link between refrigerant supply, certified technician identity, and equipment service record
structure.critical_dependency: Wholesaler participation and routine use by certified heat-pump technicians

thesis: Give HVAC wholesalers a co-branded serial-number service ledger that certified contractors complete at each refrigerant purchase or service visit, creating repeat revenue and a permissioned failure-history asset.
title: F-Gas ServiceChain Ledger
uncertainties: Unknown whether wholesalers can legally and commercially connect purchaser records to downstream asset-service data.
